examples.original: A scientist discovers strange fossils in Antarctica that seem to predate known life on Earth.
examples.styled: Dr. Harrison's trembling hands clutched the ancient specimens, his mind reeling at their non-euclidean geometries. These fossils, extracted from the bottomless ice of Antarctica's elder mountains, bore impossible patterns that defied all known taxonomies of terrestrial life. As he studied their otherworldly configurations under his microscope, a creeping dread began to gnaw at the edges of his sanity, whispering terrible suggestions about life's true origins on our planet. The specimens seemed to mock our primitive understanding of biology, their very existence hinting at vast epochs of time before what we foolishly considered the dawn of life itself.

examples.original: While renovating an old house, a family finds mysterious symbols carved into the basement walls.
examples.styled: The Winters family's renovation project became a descent into madness when they discovered those blasphemous carvings. The basement walls, ancient stone that predated the house itself, bore eldritch symbols that seemed to writhe and shift in the beam of their flashlights. Mrs. Winters found herself drawn to them against her will, her dreams increasingly plagued by visions of vast, cyclopean cities beneath the waves, where things that should not be slumbered in waiting. The local historian's subsequent disappearance, after merely viewing photographs of the carvings, only hinted at the cosmic horror they had unwittingly uncovered.
